content.text:
Waived fees no longer count as owed, so checkout stops refusing a member over them and the account summary stops showing them. All 61 tests pass, including the one I added.

Checkout eligibility and the summary route both get a member's balance from `outstandingBalance` in `lib/fees/balance.js`. It only skipped fees marked `paid`, so a waived fee, which has `waivedReason` set but isn't paid, still counted. It now skips a fee if it is paid or waived, and I updated its doc comment to say so.

I added a test in `test/fees.test.js`. It waives one of two fees and checks that only the other counts.

One earlier shell command was blocked by the permissions check, so I made the edits with the file tools. Nothing was changed by the blocked command.

I haven't committed anything.
